name: Protect .kiro From Being Gitignored
description: Fails if .gitignore is edited to ignore .kiro (which would disqualify the Kiroween submission).

then.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const t=fs.readFileSync('.gitignore','utf8'); if(/^\/?\.kiro/m.test(t)){console.error('ERROR: .kiro must NEVER be in .gitignore!'); process.exit(1);}"
